newsitem.title: USA: TV's original Maytag "repairman" Jesse White dies.
newsitem.headline: TV's original Maytag "repairman" Jesse White dies.

text.p: Veteran television and movie actor Jesse White, probably best-known as the lonely washing machine repairman in a series of Maytag TV ads, has died, a hospital spokeswoman said Friday. He was 79.
Charlie Lahaie, of the Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre, said White died of cardiac arrest Wednesday night following surgery. She declined to specify the surgery.
White, who specialised in comic or character roles, appeared in several films including "Harvey" with Jimmy Stewart and the all-star comedy, "It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World".

He acted in many TV series, including a long-running role as Danny Thomas' agent in "Make Room for Daddy". He also appeared opposite Thomas' daughter Marlo Thomas in "That Girl", and his last small screen role was in an episode of "Seinfeld" last year.

But most viewers recognised him as the Maytag repairman, who had nothing to do because the washing machines were so reliable. He played the part in the TV spots for 22 years, before retiring several years ago.
Born in Buffalo, New York and raised in Akron, Ohio, White is survived by his wife Celia, two daughters, two sisters, two brothers and three grandchildren.
